clue.text: Contact sport Islamic judge holds undesirable

indicators.note: the judge's title wraps around the word for undesirable, holding it within

parts.note: a kadi (or qadi) is a judge in a Muslim community
something undesirable is bad

explanation.surface: A combative game in which a sharia judge keeps hold of an unwanted person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holds' wraps the judge's title around the undesirable word; the judge's title is usually spelt qadi.
explanation.definitionFit: Kabaddi is a South Asian team game of tagging and wrestling, a sport built on physical contact.

clue.text: King always holds place for astronomer

indicators.note: the always word wraps around the place abbreviation

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A monarch is always keeping a position for his stargazer.
explanation.definitionFit: Johannes Kepler was the German astronomer who formulated the laws of planetary motion.

clue.text: What's helpful with common weeds in rough country

parts.note: a boon is something helpful, a blessing
docks are common broad-leaved weeds

explanation.surface: Weeds are useful when you're out in the wilds.
explanation.definitionFit: The boondocks are remote, wild or backwoods terrain, an American expression for the back of beyond.

clue.text: Ballerina's partner regrets nothing when too short in lifting

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: rues means regrets

indicators.note: too short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: nada is Spanish slang for nothing

explanation.surface: A dancer regrets nothing, except when he is too short to lift his partner.
explanation.walkthrough: NADA trimmed is NAD; RUES + NAD read upwards gives DANSEUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A danseur is a male ballet dancer, the man who partners and lifts the ballerina.

clue.text: One manic son unfortunately is not sleeping

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests the letters have come out badly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A frantic boy, sadly, can't get to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: I (one) comes first, then MANIC SON rearranged gives NSOMNIAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Insomniac as an adjective describes someone suffering from sleeplessness, unable to fall asleep.

clue.text: Reveal in error using grams for tons where one may be caught out

definitions.text: where one may be caught out

indicators.note: using one thing in place of another signals a letter swap in the phrase
for marks what is being replaced: the grams letter stands in for the tons letter

parts.note: to let slip is to reveal something by mistake
G is the abbreviation for grams

explanation.surface: A confession about mixing up weights: someone wrote grams where tons were meant.
explanation.walkthrough: LET SLIP with its T changed to G gives LEG SLIP. Leg slip is a cricket fielding position behind the batsman on the leg side, where catches are taken.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a batsman can be caught out by a fielder standing at that position, so it is a place where dismissals happen.

clue.text: Record includes an unknown composer

indicators.note: includes puts the unknown letter inside the record word

parts.note: a list is a record
Z is a standard algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A recording features a little-known composer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record' tempts as LP or disc; here it is LIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Liszt was the Hungarian pianist and composer of the Romantic era.

clue.text: Real information on audiences found to be regularly lacking

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: regularly lacking means every other letter is dropped, keeping the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: Data about audience numbers turns out to be periodically missing.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping alternate letters of audiences leaves UINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Genuine means authentic, true and not fake.

clue.text: A measure of illumination men found in ancient Egyptian city

parts.note: a lux is the SI unit of illuminance
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers, i.e. men

explanation.surface: Soldiers measure the lighting in an old city on the Nile.
explanation.definitionFit: Luxor stands on the site of ancient Thebes, beside the Nile in Egypt.

clue.text: We help in transporting firework

indicators.note: transporting carries the letters into new positions, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Helpers carry a firework to the display.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinwheel is a Catherine wheel, the spinning firework pinned to a post.

clue.text: Forecast of programme numbers is to follow

parts.note: prog is a short form of programme

explanation.surface: A broadcast schedule predicts that the figures will come next.
explanation.definitionFit: A prognosis is a prediction, especially of how an illness will develop.

clue.text: Nothing working for disgraced politician

parts.note: nix is slang for nothing
a machine that is on is working

explanation.surface: A shamed public figure is now out of a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Nixon resigned the US presidency in disgrace after the Watergate scandal.

clue.text: Provide last with no end for cobbler

indicators.note: with no says a letter is dropped from the word for last

parts.note: to endure is to last

indicators.note: the end for the word cobbler is its final letter

explanation.surface: A shoemaker is supplied with a last, the foot-shaped block on which shoes are made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last' and 'cobbler' make a shoemaking picture, but last is a verb here. ENDURE loses R, the last letter of cobbler.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue someone with a quality is to provide or endow them with it.

clue.text: Elderly mother mostly suffering during parade

indicators.note: during puts the trimmed suffering word inside the parade word

parts.note: a march is a parade

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a trial is a hardship or suffering

explanation.surface: An old mum, largely in pain, joins a procession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the final L of the suffering word, and 'during' puts what is left inside the parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is the senior woman of a family, typically its elderly mother or grandmother.

clue.text: 20-style vehicle unlike any other, failing to start around valleys

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: around puts the shortened unique word on either side of the valleys word
failing to start means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: something unique is unlike any other
vales are valleys

explanation.surface: A one-of-a-kind car that will not start, broken down among the valleys.
explanation.walkthrough: '20' refers to the answer at 20 down, a word for a festive holiday. 'failing to start' drops the U, giving NIQUE, and 'around' wraps it about the valleys.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festive celebration, so fiesta-style means having the flavour of a carnival.

clue.text: A daughter marrying next door

parts.note: marrying is joining two people together

explanation.surface: A girl is getting married to the boy who lives next door.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjoining rooms or houses share a wall, being immediately beside each other.

clue.text: See nurse running after question: "vaguely unwell feeling?"

indicators.note: after places the rearranged letters behind the question abbreviation
running suggests the letters are in motion, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient is told to see a nurse, who asks whether they feel a bit off.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling queer in the old sense means feeling faintly ill, so queerness is mild sickness.

clue.text: Bishop pondered over introducing iodine and resin used as incense

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: introducing brings the iodine symbol into the reversed word
over says the pondered word is turned round

parts.note: mulled means pondered
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A cleric muses on adding iodine to an aromatic gum for church use.
explanation.walkthrough: MULLED backwards is DELLUM; I goes in to give DELLIUM, after B.
explanation.definitionFit: Bdellium is a fragrant gum resin from Commiphora trees, burnt as incense.

clue.text: One trying locally in redevelopment to just direct dig

indicators.note: redevelopment suggests the letters are rebuilt into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions for a building project: send the digger in straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trying' here means trying legal cases, and 'locally' marks a judge working in a regional court.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of judge hears cases in a regional court, so they are someone who tries cases in a particular area.

clue.text: An American's very corrupt over local estate agent

parts.note: in American usage real means very, as in real good

indicators.note: over says the corrupt word is turned round

parts.note: to rot is to corrupt

explanation.surface: A US property dealer is thoroughly crooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' points to the American setting already signalled, where this is the usual word.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US a realtor is someone who sells houses and land, the counterpart of a British estate agent.

clue.text: See and record short-tailed eagle

parts.note: a disc is a record

indicators.note: short-tailed means the bird's name loses its last letter

parts.note: an erne is a sea eagle

explanation.surface: Watch and log a sighting of an eagle with a stubby tail.
explanation.definitionFit: To discern is to perceive or make out, as when one sees something.

clue.text: Some selfies taken to show holiday

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Photos snapped of oneself are proof of a trip away.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festive holiday in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: What's often used for boundaries, ideally in taking on new layout

indicators.note: a new layout is a fresh arrangement, so these letters are set out differently

explanation.surface: Garden planning: a hedge would sit ideally within a fresh design.
explanation.walkthrough: IDEALLY plus IN are rearranged. Leylandii are fast-growing conifers, a common and much-disputed choice for garden hedges in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: These cypress trees are planted widely as hedges marking property lines between neighbouring gardens.

clue.text: Support given over including English poet

indicators.note: including puts the English letter inside the reversed support word
given over means the support word is turned upside down in this down clue

parts.note: a stay is a support or prop

explanation.surface: Backing a writer of English verse.
explanation.walkthrough: STAY reversed is YATS; E goes in: Y-E-ATS.
explanation.definitionFit: W B Yeats was the Irish poet and Nobel laureate.

clue.text: Use up time over video which may be launched by club

definitions.text: which may be launched by club

indicators.note: in a down clue, using the letters upwards means reading them from bottom to top

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Run out the clock by watching the replay, the kind of footage a club might release.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Use up' looks like consume, but it tells you to read T + O + VID upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A divot is the piece of turf a golf club sends flying during a shot.

clue.text: South-eastern Arabic music for khan

parts.note: rai is a style of popular music from Algeria, sung in Arabic

explanation.surface: A list of regional Arabic styles of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'khan' looks like a ruler's title but here means an inn.
explanation.definitionFit: A khan is a caravanserai, an inn for travellers in the Middle East, which is also called a serai.

clue.text: Sleep during sex is unseemly

indicators.note: during puts the sleep word inside the sex word

parts.note: it is a coy word for sex
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: Nodding off in the middle of lovemaking is poor form.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inapt is unsuitable or inappropriate, much as unseemly behaviour is improper.

clue.text: Not immoral about old lacking representation

indicators.note: about places the word for not immoral around the old letter

parts.note: viceless means free of vice, so not immoral

explanation.surface: A virtuous person in times past who had nobody to speak for them.
explanation.definitionFit: Those with no voice have no say, meaning nobody speaks or stands up for them.

clue.text: Fur's an essential if covering chest over

definitions.note: the definition is Fur, with the apostrophe s standing for is

indicators.note: covering puts the essential word around the reversed chest

parts.note: a must is an essential

indicators.note: over says the chest word is turned round

parts.note: an ark is a chest or box

explanation.surface: Fur is essential if you want to cover up your chest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns the chest word round, and 'covering' puts the essential word around it; the 's of Fur's is just 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelt of this North American rodent is sold as fur, so the animal's name is also used for the fur.

clue.text: Shrub that's regularly green is provided by volunteers

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of green is taken

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's army of part-time volunteers

explanation.surface: A plant that keeps green is supplied by voluntary helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: Alternate letters of green, starting from the first, give GEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Genista is the broom genus, a group of yellow-flowered bushes.
